title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: Part 350011 – 2027 pricing for 7.5 kW motor: counterproposal
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for your offer for part:350011. We value our long partnership and want a stable, sustainable price for 2027.

Our forecast fc:350011@2026-09 records a volume change of 11.9 %.

Our commitment is 6,110 pcs per year over a 12-month contract from 1 January 2027. In return, we propose the attached alternatives without an index clause. One alternative extends payment to 60 days, which we can offer as a trade.

Since the requested change exceeds 2 %, could you please submit our proposal to your pricing committee for an authorised review? Could you also tell us how much of your 2027 copper need is already hedged, and at what dates?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: Part 350011 – 2027 pricing for 7.5 kW motor: counterproposal
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We appreciate the confirmed volume increase and have fully factored this into our revised calculation.

Our present Angebot stands at a price of €371.07 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. As an alternative, we therefore propose a revised price of €369.02 per unit, maintaining our standard 30-day payment terms at a price of €369.02 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Please note that our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: part:350011 – 2027 package with extended payment terms
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for your revised offer. We want to agree a stable 2027 price that works for both sides.

To make this easier, we have attached two complete packages. Both cover 6,110 pcs per year over a 12-month contract from 1 January 2027, with no index clause. One package extends payment to 90 days, which lowers our financing cost and gives you room on price.

As the change is above 2 %, could your pricing committee review these packages at its next meeting? If neither works, could you tell us which payment term lets you offer your best price? We would also welcome any cheaper motor variant that meets the same specification.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: part:350011 – 2027 package with extended payment terms
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our updated Angebot stands at a price of €372.31 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

We have reviewed your packages and propose a revised price of €370.25 based on 60-day payment terms. As an alternative, we can offer a price of €370.25 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. Regarding your questions, shorter payment terms allow for our best pricing, and our technical team can evaluate alternative motor variants.

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Please provide the underlying data for your volume claims so we may review them. Which volume can you commit to?

This Angebot remains valid for 30 days. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

Application Engineering: Please note that we build strictly according to your provided drawing, and we do not propose any design changes.

messages.subject: part:350011 – volume commitment and revised 2027 packages
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for your revised offer and your answers.

On volume, our firm commitment is 6,110 pcs per year over a 12-month contract from 1 January 2027, with delivery DAP.

We also need the price to reflect delivery performance. Your scorecard sc:70510@2026Q3 records an on-time delivery rate of 90.4 %. The same scorecard records 273 ppm, which is above your standard commitment of 250 ppm.

We have attached two complete packages without an index clause, one at 90 days and one at 60 days. Could your pricing committee review them at its next meeting? We would welcome your technical team's proposal for a cheaper motor variant.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: part:350011 – volume commitment and revised 2027 packages
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your updated packages and verified the delivery and quality data you cited. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our primary offer stands at a price of €372.11 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. In response to your movement, we propose a revised price of €370.05 per unit for 60-day payment terms, with a price of €370.05 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.

Our technical team is evaluating alternative motor variants, though please note we manufacture strictly according to your provided drawing. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. Our offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
